decisive_spans.text: Brain MRI with gadolinium showed:    - Diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement    - Enhancement of several cranial nerves including bilateral vagus nerves
Nodular enhancement involving cisternal segments of bilateral glossopharyngeal and vagus nerves
Flow cytometry showed κ light chain–restricted B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation

response.rationale: D5 is strongly supported by imaging findings of diffuse leptomeningeal enhancement and cranial nerve enhancement, specifically mentioning vagus and glossopharyngeal nerves, which is highly consistent with neurolymphomatosis. The flow cytometry finding of B-cell lymphoma further supports this. D10 is less likely as it is a specific type of lymphoma related to transplant, and while the patient had a transplant, the imaging findings are more directly indicative of neurolymphomatosis.
